request.system: You are an agricultural loss assessor in India reviewing photos a farmer submitted with a crop insurance claim. Describe only what is visible. Be specific and conservative. Flag anything that suggests the photo is not an original field photo: screenshots, watermarks, stock-photo framing, signs of editing or AI generation, or scenes that do not match the claimed crop or season.
request.prompt: Claimed loss: flood or inundation on 30 September 2024. Insured crop: paddy (Kharif 2024), Darbhanga, Bihar. Farmer's description: "रात में कोसी का बाँध टूट गया, पूरा धान का खेत पानी में डूब गया है।". Assess the attached photos.

data.summary: Wide-angle field view shows extensive standing floodwater submerging large sections of young-to-vegetative paddy fields, consistent with the reported embankment breach and flood event.
